question: Should a manually resized primary Control UI composer use one browser-local height across all chat sessions, rather than session-scoped state or automatic sizing only?
rationale: The implementation is technically bounded and reversible, but the storage scope determines the long-term user-facing layout contract and cannot be selected safely from code alone.

options.title: Approve global layout preference
options.body: Keep the dedicated browser-local height because composer size is a screen/workflow preference, remains opt-in, and can be reset to automatic sizing at any time.

options.title: Use session-scoped sizing
options.body: Move the preference into conversation-scoped state if maintainers want each chat to retain an independent composer layout.

options.title: Keep automatic sizing only
options.body: Decline persistent manual sizing if the Control UI should avoid adding another remembered layout behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve global layout preference
recommendation.body: Keep the dedicated browser-local height because composer size is a screen/workflow preference, remains opt-in, and can be reset to automatic sizing at any time.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision is product scope for a core Control UI interaction, not a contributor-side correctness repair.
